Query:
UNLOAD (SELECT bs.county AS county, sum(1) AS metadata_rows_count, count(distinct(bs.bldg_id)) AS model_count, sum(bs.weight) AS units_count, sum(bs."out.electricity.total.energy_consumption..kwh" * bs.weight) AS "electricity.total.energy_consumption..kwh" FROM comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_md_agg_by_state_and_county_parquet AS bs WHERE bs.applicability = true AND bs.upgrade = 0 AND bs.state = 'CO' AND bs.bldg_id IN (46369, 46370, 46381, 46382, 46803, 46813, 46897, 46898) AND ((bs.bldg_id, bs.county, bs.state) NOT IN (SELECT bs.bldg_id, bs.county, bs.state FROM comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_md_agg_by_state_and_county_parquet AS bs WHERE bs.upgrade IN (1, 11) AND bs.applicability = true GROUP BY bs.bldg_id, bs.county, bs.state)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1) 
 TO 's3://resstock-core/bsq_athena_unload_results/e05a5259ec5365c6e2b819ae6f33acaf28ceda17261365ab3ddd725ca9f1a5e5/217e0766-5300-4100-8ab7-8b525dee42dc/' 
 WITH (format = 'PARQUET')
